FN-FKWPE55-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 113
Committee: Fiscal Responsibility and Sponsor: Senator Chris Elliott
Economic Development
Analyst: Tiffany Weaver Date: 01/13/2026
Senate Bill 113 as introduced would provide for the continuance of the Alabama Behavior
Analyst Licensing Board until October 1, 2027 pursuant to the Alabama Sunset Law. The
provisions of this bill will not otherwise affect state or local funding.
Page 1

FN-FKWPE55-2
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 113
Committee: Boards, Agencies and Sponsor: Senator Chris Elliott
Commissions
Analyst: Tiffany Weaver Date: 02/10/2026
Senate Bill 113 as passed the Senate would convert the current Alabama Behavior Analyst
Licensing Board to the Alabama Behavior Analyst Advisory Council under the Alabama
Department of Mental Health (ADMH) and transfer all property of the Council to ADMH. This
bill would increase the administrative obligations of ADMH by an undetermined amount
dependent upon the cost to regulate behavioral analysts and other licensees of the former board.
However, these obligations would be offset by license fees collected by ADMH for licensees.
Further, this bill would rename the Alabama Behavior Analyst Licensing Board Fund to the
Alabama Behavior Analyst Advisory Council Fund to be administered by ADMH. For FY 2025,
total estimated funds available to the board were $69,235.
